# QT Imaging to Showcase Its Breast Acoustic CT™ Technology at RSNA 2026


November 23, 2026 8:30am EST


*Company to demonstrate radiation-free, compression-free, quantitative 3D breast imaging as it prepares for expanded U.S. clinical adoption following landmark Medicare reimbursement decision*


PETALUMA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- **QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: QTI) (“QT Imaging” or the “Company”),** a medical device company dedicated to transforming breast health management through innovative, radiation-free imaging technology, today announced that it will showcase its FDA-cleared Breast Acoustic CT™ technology at the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA) 2026 Annual Meeting, November 29–December 3, in Chicago, Illinois. QT Imaging will exhibit within the Canon Medical USA booth at McCormick Place.


RSNA 2026 comes at a pivotal time for QT Imaging. The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) recently established separate Medicare hospital outpatient payment for eligible, medically necessary diagnostic QTscan examinations, effective January 1, 2027. This reimbursement milestone creates an important foundation for expanding clinical adoption and patient access across the United States.


QT Imaging's Breast Acoustic CT™ Scanner uses automated transmission and reflection ultrasound to generate high-resolution, three-dimensional breast images without ionizing radiation, breast compression, or intravenous contrast agents. The technology also provides quantitative measurements of tissue properties, including speed of sound, reflection intensity, and attenuation, supporting more objective breast tissue characterization.


At RSNA, QT Imaging will highlight its integrated imaging capabilities, including the QTI-Olea Viewer, designed to support efficient interpretation of QTscan images and connectivity with existing hospital PACS environments. The company will also discuss its QTI Precision Pathway™ cloud platform and its strategy for advancing quantitative imaging and precision breast oncology.


"RSNA provides an important opportunity to engage directly with radiologists and healthcare institutions as we enter a new phase of global commercial adoption," said Satrajit Misra, Chief Commercial Officer of QT Imaging. "With Medicare reimbursement taking effect in January, our priority is to bring quantitative 3D breast imaging into clinical practice and make this technology accessible to more women. We look forward to demonstrating how QTscan can complement existing breast imaging modalities and provide physicians with additional information to support patient care."


Healthcare professionals, institutional representatives, and prospective partners attending RSNA 2026 are invited to meet the QT Imaging team within the Canon Medical USA booth, in the Ultrasound Section: North Hall, #6713 & #7313 to learn more about Breast Acoustic CT™ technology and its clinical applications.


**About QT Imaging**


QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: QTI) is a medical device company engaged in the research, development, and commercialization of innovative imaging systems that use low-frequency sound waves. QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. strives to improve global health outcomes. Its strategy is predicated upon the fact that medical imaging is critical to the detection, diagnosis, and treatment of disease and that it should be safe, affordable, accessible, and centered on the patient’s experience. For more information on QT Imaging Holdings, Inc., please visit the Company’s website at[www.qtimaging.com](http://www.qtimaging.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/qt-imaging-holdings/) .
